name: Separation-Margin Complement Bound
statement: For proper nonempty $C$ with nonempty cube complement $C^{\mathrm c}$, $\mu(C^{\mathrm c})\ge\mu(C)/(2r(C^{\mathrm c})-\mu(C))$. The bound is sharp for positioned cubes.
proof: Average certificate witnesses over the positioned cubes complementary to minimal missing patterns, then exchange the resulting cube data with separator rows. Normalization loses exactly the displayed factor.
